speech.title: Model
speech.description: On-device transcription. Audio never leaves your machine.
speech.readyDescription: On-device transcription is active. Audio stays local.
speech.missingDescription: Download the on-device transcription model to start transcribing locally (~1.2 GB).
speech.storageDescription: ~1.2 GB total for the transcription model.

llm.title: Local AI model
llm.description: Run an assistant entirely on this device. It works offline, and your data never leaves the machine.
llm.sizeHint: Bigger models tend to give better answers, but use more memory and take longer to download.

custom.title: Custom Hugging Face model
custom.description: Download any GGUF model from Hugging Face by repo id. Add an access token for gated or private repos.
custom.useCached: Already downloaded it? Use the cached copy

folder.title: Use a model from your computer
folder.description: Already have model files on disk, from huggingface-cli, LM Studio, or an earlier download? Point StageWhisper at the folder.
folder.hint: Pick a folder with a .gguf file inside. Ollama models won't work here, since Ollama keeps them in its own format.

llm.footer: Local models run entirely on your device.
